headline: US and Philippines Reach Major Bilateral Trade Agreement
summary: US President Donald Trump announced that the United States and the Philippines have concluded a major new bilateral trade agreement.
why: The trade pact strengthens commercial and supply chain ties between Washington and Manila amid escalating economic rivalry across the Indo-Pacific.
